dlg.ba_nghiem.greet: You're here. Linh Pho hasn't disappeared. It just forgot how to be seen.
dlg.ba_nghiem.task: This shop is yours now. What would you like to ask first?
dlg.ba_nghiem.market: This is an imaginary night market. It sleeps by day and wakes when evening comes.
dlg.ba_nghiem.what_to_do: Go to Miss Lam's workshop. She will show you how to make your first lantern.
dlg.ba_nghiem.return: Has the lantern by the door lit up yet? If not, go see Miss Lam at the workshop.
dlg.co_lam.greet: Nobody has made lanterns here for a long time. Ask me if you need anything.
dlg.co_lam.recipe: A Wooden Lantern needs 2 bamboo, 1 dó paper and 1 hemp rope. Come back once you have them.
dlg.ong_do.greet: The bridge leads to Sương Landing. There's only mist here and a few old boats.
dlg.ong_do.materials: There's plenty of bamboo on the bank. Take only what you need and leave some for others.
dlg.bac.greet: It's me, Bấc! Soon you'll have the Spirit Lamp, so you can see the faint traces here.
dlg.choice.market: What kind of market is this?
dlg.choice.anything_here: Is there anything to gather here?
